title: Character Sketch Of Miss Paulette, Who Claims To Be

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. I. REGISTRY
T.S.6, Special Branch Dxxxxxx,
REPORT
December 16, '37

Subject PAULETTE, Miss. - Advertisement in the Shanghai Evening Post and
Mercury dated December 1, 1937.

Mark A. and For info D.S.I. Medvedeff.

Reference to the attached advertisement in the
"Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury" dated December 1, 1937,
I have to state that Miss. PAULETTE, who claims to be a
French citizen, previously resided at the Embankment Building
Apartment 617, with other two French ladies, for a period of
about one year.

This apartment was registered in the name of Miss.
R. Gourbet, French, who on 1-12-37 removed to 233, Race
Course Road, Apartment 12, telephone 37965.

At present, there are two French ladies residing
in this apartment which since 1-10-37 is registered in the
name of Mrs. M.L. Boyer, French, but a telephone in this
apartment is registered in the name of Miss R. Goubbeit.

According to reliable information, Mrs. M.L. Boyer
is a paramour of Mr. G. Lalourcey, French citizen, proprietor
of the "Fantasio" Cafe at 3-5, Rue Chu Pao San.

G. Lalourcey is strongly suspected of renting
several flats in different parts of the Settlement and French
Concession and using them as brothels.

Neither of the above-mentioned females are
registered with the French Consulate-General.

N. Medvedeff
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

主题：PAULETTE 小姐——刊登于1937年12月1日《上海晚邮报与信使报》（Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury）的广告。

批注 A。供 D.S.I. Medvedeff 知悉。

关于附上的1937年12月1日《上海晚邮报与信使报》中的广告，本人须陈述如下：声称拥有法国公民身份的 PAULETTE 小姐，此前曾与其他两位法国女士在百老汇大厦（Embankment Building）617室居住约一年时间。

该公寓登记在法国籍 R. Gourbet 小姐名下，她已于1937年12月1日搬至跑马厅路（Race Course Road）233号12室，电话37965。

目前，有两位法国女士居住在该公寓内，该公寓自1937年10月1日起登记在法国籍 M.L. Boyer 太太名下，但该公寓内的电话却登记在 R. Goubbeit 小姐名下。

据可靠消息，M.L. Boyer 太太是法国公民、朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）3-5号“Fantasio”咖啡馆业主 G. Lalourcey 先生的情妇。

G. Lalourcey 被强烈怀疑在公共租界和法租界的不同地段租赁了多套公寓，并将其用作妓院。

上述女性均未在法国总领事馆进行登记。

N. Medvedeff
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

警司 (特别支部)

page_data.en:
INFORMATION

Miss Paulette GOUBERT, French, about 30 years of age,
is a woman of uncertain morals; she arrived in Shanghai
about 18 months ago.

According to our information, she stayed in Singapore
and Hongkong for several months prior to coming to Shanghai.

This woman is very well educated and on several
occasions has boasted that she has studied medicine. She
possesses a perfect knowledge of English.

Since her arrival in Shanghai she has frequented
the company of foreign (European) prostitutes and was
on particularly good terms with one MISERAZZI who used
to reside at 611 Embankment Building, which address
was employed by her as a house of assignation.

During her stay at the flat of this woman MISERAZZI,
Paulette GOUBERT frequented brothels located at 995
Connaught Road and 17 Soochow Road when she was in
constant close contact with the brothel-keepers.

Later she leased in her name an apartment at 617
Embankment Building which in turn she used as a house
of assignation.

The Sino-Japanese hostilities having forced her to
leave her flat, she took shelter at an address which, at
the moment we do not know, but some days ago she inserted
the following announcement in the Shanghai Evening Post &
Mercury: "Miss Paulette, who formerly resided at 617
Embankment Building, wishes to inform her friends that
she will be happy to receive them at No. 233 Race Course
Road, Apartment No. 12 - Telephone No. 37965."

It is probable that this address is now being used
by Paulette GOUBERT as a house of assignation.

〔此处转录不清〕
P.A. to D.C. (Enquiries)
page_data.zh:
情报

Paulette GOUBERT 小姐，法国人，约30岁，
品行不端；她于大约18个月前抵达上海。

据我方掌握的情报，她在来上海之前，曾在新加坡
和香港停留数月。

该女子受过良好教育，并曾多次吹嘘自己学过医。她
精通英语。

自抵达上海以来，她经常与外籍（欧洲）妓女交往，并与一位名叫 MISERAZZI 的女子关系尤为密切，后者曾居住在百老汇大厦（Embankment Building）611号，该地址被她用作幽会场所。

在 MISERAZZI 的公寓居住期间，Paulette GOUBERT 经常光顾位于康纳路（Connaught Road）995号和苏州路（Soochow Road）17号的妓院，并与这些妓院的经营者保持密切的联系。

后来，她以自己的名义租赁了百老汇大厦（Embankment Building）617室的一套公寓，并将其用作幽会场所。

由于中日战事迫使她离开该公寓，她避难于一个我们目前尚不知晓的地址，但几天前她在《上海晚邮报与信使报》上刊登了以下公告：“此前居住在百老汇大厦（Embankment Building）617室的 Paulette 小姐，谨告知其友人，她将在跑马厅路（Race Course Road）233号12室愉快地接待他们——电话号码 37965。”

很可能 Paulette GOUBERT 现在正将该地址用作幽会场所。
